law_name: Data Protection and Privacy Act No. 13 of 2024
jurisdiction: Digital Safety Authority (Deputy Commissioner for data protection)
scope: Data subjects whose personal data is processed in Vanuatu (public and private sectors)
applies_to: Public and private sector controllers and processors
key_requirements: Rights of access, rectification, erasure and restriction reported; oversight framework with offences and penalties; consent details not verified (unconfirmed)
enforcement_authority: Digital Safety Authority (Digital Safety Authority Act No. 15 of 2024; reportedly not yet operational)
exemptions: Processing purely for personal or household activities
notes: Sources conflict: assent 2024-12-01 vs 2024-12-05; commencement 2025-01-02 vs 2025-02-01; official text not opened
